title: Use your hands for praise, not stain
summary: Hands are called good when they become instruments of praise rather than tools of impulse or vanity.
takeaway: Let the next reach of your hands move toward praise.
lifeApplication: Before the next reflexive reach—to type, take, buy, or argue—pause and redirect your hands toward something the Lord’s path can bless.

source.shortMeaning: Hands become holy when they are given to praise and clean work.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next reflexive reach, ask what your hands are serving.

evidence.coreClaim: Hands become holy when they are given to praise and clean work.
evidence.turn: The shabad turns ordinary hands and feet into signs of devotion when they serve praise and walk the Lord’s way.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before the next reflexive reach—to type, take, buy, or argue—pause and redirect your hands toward something the Lord’s path can bless.
